rationale: The statistical core matches the reference exactly: one DESeq2 fit on all twelve samples with ~condition and control releveled as reference, an LRT against ~1 for the omnibus question, and two Wald contrasts against control from the same object with apeglm/ashr shrinkage and per-test BH at 0.05, plus an explicit warning not to pair LRT p-values with fold changes. The low count filter (>=10 in at least 4 samples, tied to group size) and in-model size-factor normalization are stated and justified. Sample QC is nearly absent, however: only a dispersion plot and a sample-order check are named, with no PCA, distance matrix, library-size review, or outlier policy, and the |LFC|>=1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold. Enrichment was not asked for and the reference omits it; the plan adds ORA with a sensible filtered-gene universe and named collection but no version or set-size window, and the report lacks package versions.
